title: Security Key (YubiKey) or Authenticator App: Which Second Factor Should You Use?
excerpt: Hardware security keys and authenticator apps both beat SMS codes, but they protect against different things. This comparison weighs phishing resistance against cost and convenience.
verdict: A FIDO2 security key such as a YubiKey gives the strongest protection for high-value accounts, because it will not authenticate to a fake site, though it costs money and is one more thing to carry. An authenticator app is a practical and much better-than-SMS choice for most people, but its one-time codes can still be relayed by a real-time phishing site.
